display.purpose: Hero headings and primary section titles. Weight 900 + uppercase creates authority without requiring extreme scale.

body.purpose: Narrative text, tour descriptions, FAQ answers. Cap at 65-75ch on reading-heavy pages.

label.purpose: UI chrome only: buttons, badges, nav items, category tags. All-caps at 11px with wide tracking.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Interactive cards and tour items on hover. Paired with translateY(-4px).

shadows.name: floating-surface
shadows.purpose: Mega menu dropdowns, modals — surfaces that communicate z-plane separation.

shadows.name: grounding-tint
shadows.purpose: Optional ambient anchor for cards in dense grids. Use conservatively.

motion.name: ease-default
motion.purpose: Default state transitions: color, border, background.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The sole conversion CTA. Phosphor green. Used for Book Now, submit, confirm actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #9fce33; color: #1a1a1a; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.075em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.46, 0.03, 0.52, 0.96), transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.46, 0.03, 0.52, 0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #8cb82b; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9fce33; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action. Obsidian fill. Used for View All Tours, navigate, non-booking flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #1a1a1a; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.075em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.46, 0.03, 0.52, 0.96); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #333333; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1a1a1a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Tertiary action. 2px obsidian border, transparent fill. Fills to obsidian on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: transparent; color: #1a1a1a; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.075em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 10px 22px; border: 2px solid #1a1a1a; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.46, 0.03, 0.52, 0.96), color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.46, 0.03, 0.52, 0.96); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background-color: #1a1a1a; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9fce33; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-tour-card { background-color: #ffffff; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.18, 1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.18, 1); } .ds-tour-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); } .ds-tour-card-img { width: 100%; height: 200px; background-color: #f5f5f5; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #6b7280; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-tour-card-body { padding: 24px; } .ds-tour-card-tag { display: inline-block; background-color: #f5f5f5; color: #1a1a1a; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-tour-card-title { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 800; color: #1a1a1a; margin: 0 0 8px 0; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-tour-card-desc { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; color: #333333; line-height: 1.65; margin: 0 0 16px 0; } .ds-tour-card-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; } .ds-tour-card-price { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1a1a1a; } .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #9fce33; color: #1a1a1a; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0.075em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 10px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #8cb82b; }

components.name: Trust Badge
components.description: Verification chip for legal credentials, police association, and review scores. Always links to source. The green checkmark is the signal — its presence means the claim is documented.
components.html: GOVERNMENT LICENSED
components.css: .ds-trust-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background-color: #f5f5f5; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 10px; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.46, 0.03, 0.52, 0.96); } .ds-trust-badge:hover { border-color: #9fce33; } .ds-trust-badge-icon { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-trust-badge-label { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #333333; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input. Bordered, flat, 4px radius. Focus shifts border weight — no color glow.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1a1a1a; } .ds-field-input { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 400; color: #333333; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.46, 0.03, 0.52, 0.96); } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #9ca3af; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: #6b7280; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9fce33; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
This system treats every screen like a pre-expedition briefing document: purposeful, structured, nothing wasted. The visual language of a trusted operator who has run 200 tours doesn't need decoration — it needs clarity. Every element earns its place the same way a line item on a safety checklist earns its place: because it's true, not because it looks good.

The palette is deliberately minimal. Near-black for authority. A single phosphor green for action and verification. White for content surfaces. Off-white for section breathing room. The green functions like a trail marker in low-visibility conditions — not decorative, immediately readable, trusted because it's functional.

This system rejects warmth as a design strategy. Warmth compensates for weak trust signals. JVTO's trust signals are documented and verifiable — they don't need softening. The UI should feel the way the operator feels: direct, reliable, ready.
keyCharacteristics: Single-font system (Inter) with weight as the primary hierarchy tool
Sharp edges throughout — no soft card corners, no rounded-xl on containers
One active color (phosphor green) as the sole signal color per screen
Flat surfaces at rest; elevation only appears on interaction
All-caps labels for UI chrome and buttons
Content-first layouts with zero decorative elements

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Phosphor green appears on at most one interactive element per viewport. Its scarcity is the signal. Decorative use on non-interactive elements is prohibited.

rules.name: The Lime Drift Rule
rules.body: Some legacy components use bg-lime-400 or bg-lime-600 instead of the canonical #9fce33. These are audit targets. Never mix Tailwind lime-scale utilities with the custom token on the same surface.

rules.name: The Weight-as-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is expressed through Inter's weight axis — not by introducing a second typeface. If a design requires a third weight step to create distinction, the layout has too many levels. Reduce levels; don't add fonts.

rules.name: The All-Caps Constraint
rules.body: All-caps is reserved for UI chrome: buttons, labels, badges, nav items. Never apply to body copy or any text block longer than six words.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface with no interactive function has no shadow. Decorative box-shadows on static cards, dividers, or hero sections are prohibited.

dos: Do use phosphor green (#9fce33) exclusively for interactive elements and verification markers. One green signal per viewport.
Do use Inter font-black (weight 900) + uppercase + tracking-wider for section headings and hero copy.
Do default to rounded-sm (4px) for all interactive and container elements.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest. Add elevation only on hover.
Do cap body text line-length at 65-75ch on content-heavy pages.
Do use bg-jvto-green (#9fce33) — not Tailwind's bg-lime-400 or bg-lime-600.
Do link every trust badge and credential chip to its source document.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe accent on cards or callouts.
Don't round cards or panels beyond rounded-sm. rounded-xl, rounded-2xl, rounded-3xl on containers is prohibited.
Don't style like a backpacker listing — Viator-style photo tiles with overlay price badges and orange CTAs are exactly what this system rejects.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Use a single solid color.
Don't apply the TipTap purple (--tt-brand-color-*) to public-facing surfaces — it is scoped to the (cms) route only.
Don't add shadows to non-interactive static elements.
Don't use identical icon-card grids (same size, repeated 4-8 times).
Don't animate layout properties (height, width, padding, margin).
